price_why: It hands me one post I can shoot tonight with flies already on my table, plus a repeatable cover system (knolling and the specimen card) for the whole series. I'd pay a modest one-off for that, though the trend section adds little.
one_line: A research-backed brief that centres on a carefully specified hackle-density comparison carousel for beginner fly tiers, supported by patterns borrowed from other niches and a few follow-up posts.
strongest: The 'Three hackles' carousel: one variable changes and everything else is held still, which makes a beginner-friendly diagnostic post. The creator is told to use their own real turn counts.
weakest: The heavy research apparatus (repeated 'no saves seen' lines, trend and forum-view sections) takes up a lot of space but does little to help the creator decide on or make posts.
